target_customer: Startups and SMEs that need SOC 2, ISO 27001 and similar certifications to sell to enterprise buyers
problem: Founders lose weeks to compliance work. Probo acts as the compliance team: sets requirements, handles docs, risks, controls and evidence, runs the audit and keeps it current.
business_model: Managed compliance service with dedicated compliance officers (site-stated $10,000 per year per search snippet) plus free open-source self-hosted version

founders.name: Antoine Bouchardy
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a cybersecurity auditor with a data and product background.

founders.name: Bryan Frimin
founders.background_notes: YC page: French engineer building an open-source AI platform for SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly workflow software and integrations for evidence collection; the hard part is audit know-how rather than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Open source invites copying, but audit relationships and embedded evidence workflows create some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large funded compliance platforms already served the same buyers; none acquired Probo as of search.

market_need_then: SOC 2 and ISO certifications are a common enterprise sales gate, shown by established vendors; Probo's own comparison pages target Vanta and Drata users.

branding.domain_note: Launched under getprobo.com and now uses probo.com; transition date not found. Probo Medical is an unrelated company with a similar name.

identity.logo: Official brand assets page exists; design not described in sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and concise; headlines like Compliance, Done For You

branding.brand_signature: Open-source positioning, listed as the open-source alternative to Vanta on directories
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch and open-source GitHub repo getprobo/probo; no merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Open-source angle gives directory visibility, but the name is generic-sounding and brand press is thin.

outcome_analysis: Probo is active with a team of six on YC and named customers such as Ahrefs and Typebot on its site. Its open-source repo gives distribution, but it competes with well-funded Vanta and Drata. Funding data conflicts across aggregators, so its financing and trajectory remain unclear.
notes: Funding unverified: StartupIntros says $500K seed (June 2025) with a $25.5M total, Prospeo says $500K, StartupHub says $31M and a Series A. These conflict and were seen only on aggregator snippets, so no round is recorded. The StartupIntros page itself returned not found when fetched. Competitor sources found were undated or vendor-authored (Probo's own hub pages), so competitors left empty. No outcome events found; the Probo Medical acquisition is unrelated. Completeness pass: a 500K seed dated 2025-06 rests on databases only (StartupIntros, VCBacked labels it pre-seed) and is recorded as a round. Totals of 25.5M and 31M (StartupHub, Series A) conflict and are known gaps, not recorded.
